name: static-mad-analysis
description: Three-layer static-MAD analysis through video evidence, original-work context, and creator expression, with provisional AMV and ASMV extensions.

interface.shortDescription: Three-layer static-MAD analysis with source context.
interface.longDescription: Analyze static MAD through a blind video pass, focused original-work context, and a separate creator-expression layer, supported by adaptive sampling, subject-role tracking, event-response chains, time-space reconstruction, audiovisual organization, and optional cost-gated Qwen video understanding. Source context explains editorial transformation without fidelity, accessibility, or competition scoring. AMV and ASMV adapters remain provisional extensions used only when explicitly requested.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this static MAD through video-body evidence, original-work context, and creator expression.
Reconstruct the subjects, event-response chains, and time-space relations in this video.
Experiment with the provisional ASMV extension to analyze speaker roles and audiovisual argument.
